summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, then address PR review comments and unblock a staging deployment pipeline.
summary.outcome: Fixed the root cause (wrong protobuf field number in IPNS record parsing), swapped resolution order to prefer delegated routing, resolved all PR review threads, and wired Tauri signing secrets into the deploy workflow.

repo: IPNS records use protobuf field 1 for the value (CID path) and field 2 for signatureV1 — not the other way around
mock-ipns-routing is used in CI/E2E to simulate IPNS publishing; Kubo cannot resolve mock-published IPNS names via the /ipns/ gateway path
resolveIpns() tries delegated routing API first, then IPFS gateway HEAD as fallback — previously inverted, causing 15s+ hangs per resolution in CI

Tauri updater pubkey was added to tauri.conf.json but TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY/TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD were never wired into the GitHub Actions workflow for any of the three desktop build jobs (macOS, Windows, Linux)
Grafana dashboard provisioning uses a Grafana service account token (GRAFANA_API_KEY repo secret), separate from the Loki and Prometheus data source API keys
The staging VPS is at 76.13.151.200; SSH connection from GitHub Actions runners can have transient timeouts

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord() was checking fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value) when parsing the protobuf IPNS record to extract the CID path
resp.json() and resp.arrayBuffer() were both called on the same Response object — resp.json() consumes the body, making the arrayBuffer() call fail; fixed with an else branch
Retry backoff only triggered on thrown errors, not on non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx); added !resp.ok check with sleep before retry
Introduced shared RECOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS constant to keep test timeout (90s) and assertion timeout in sync; previously the 60s assertion timeout could fire before the 90s test timeout

workflow: Run E2E tests locally before committing to confirm the fix works — the user explicitly required this workflow
When Grafana Cloud /api/health returns 404 from CI (but works in browser), the cause is an expired/invalid service account token, not a URL problem
GitHub Actions SSH connection timeouts to a VPS can be transient; verify reachability before escalating
Tauri signing keypair generation: pnpm tauri signer generate -w

friction: Multiple rounds of PR review comment resolution were needed (3 separate /resolve-pr-comments invocations) as CodeRabbit kept adding new comments after each push
Outside-of-diff review comments cannot be resolved via the thread GraphQL API — required a PR comment reply instead
Background service task notifications arrived mid-session after services were already shut down, creating noise
Grafana API key miscommunication: user had Loki/Prometheus data source keys but needed a separate Grafana service account token — distinction not obvious from secret naming
Staging deploy hit a transient SSH timeout to the VPS, requiring a manual re-run
open_items: Staging deploy workflow re-run needed after Tauri signing key fix was committed — transcript ends before confirming the deploy succeeded
The .planning/config.json file has uncommitted local modifications that keep appearing in git status — never cleaned up
The desktop build failure due to missing signing keys was in the deploy-staging.yml workflow; the equivalent deploy-production.yml (if it exists) may have the same gap and should be checked
